CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
January 23, 2024 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Greg Stump, Redeemer Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Rotary Club of La Mirada
4.
ROLL CALL
5.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
6.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of January 9, 2024 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of January 9, 2024.
6.1 Minutes of 1-9-24 SS
6.1 Minutes of 1-9-24 CC
6.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated January 23, 2024 in the total amount of $1,385,439.44.
6.2 Warrant Register
6.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING NOVEMBER 2023 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending November 2023.
6.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
6.4
APPROVAL OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT “MUG RUN” – It is recommended the City Council approve the Sheriff’s Department “Mug Run” subject to conditions recommended by staff.
6.4 Approval of Mug Run
6.5
CITY COUNCIL REQUEST FOR CONFERENCE ATTENDANCE – It is recommended the City Council approve Mayor Pro Tem Sarega’s request to attend the Independent Cities Association’s Winter Seminar.
6.5 Request for Conference Attendance
6.6
THIRD AMENDMENT TO THE COMMUNICATIONS SITE LEASE AGREEMENT – AMERICAN TOWER - It is recommended the City Council approve the Third Amendment to the Communications Site Lease Agreement between the City of La Mirada and American Tower Asset Sub, LLC, subject to the lease agreement terms, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
6.6 Communications Site Lease Agreement
7.
PUBLIC HEARING
7.1
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM (CDBG) PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 PROJECTS - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; approve the proposed Fiscal Year 2024-25 Community Development Block Grant projects as presented; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments with the Los Angeles County Development Authority on behalf of the City.
7.1 Public Hearing: CDBG
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 732 REVISING REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO ENTERTAINMENT PERMITS AND AMENDING TITLE 4 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE – It is recommended the City Council accept for first reading Ordinance No. 732 revising regulations applicable to entertainment permits and amending Title 4 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Ord. No. 732 - First Reading
SUCCESSOR AGENCY

SA-35 APPROVING THE ANNUAL RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE (ROPS) 24-25 - It is recommended the City Council acting in its capacity as the Successor Agency to the La Mirada Redevelopment Agency adopt Resolution No. SA-35 approving the Annual Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule 24-25 for the annual fiscal period from July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2025 and taking certain related actions.
